Get Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom On Steam with a 10% Launch Discount!

Morio - The enigmatic creator of Yellow Taxi and a brilliant mechanic. He loves his grandma very much.

notes.title: 🎉 Introducing the 8 going on ∞ Update! 🎉
notes.content:
Greetings, friendship-ruining game enthusiasts! It's been an incredible journey of 8 years, and we’d like to thank you for sticking around with a special kind of update.  

8 is the magic number in this update, and we're bringing you some new features to keep things fresh from here to infinity! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/112ac8c5a6142b7ceb3192d7e69d5caffa6cbf94.png

🏆 Eight time's the charm! 
From March 14th to March 28th, we're rewarding players for every 8th round won during online play! That's right, not matches, but rounds! Stay sharp, because after every 8th victorious round, you'll receive a random item that you don't already own. You can do this up to 8 times a day, so keep those wins coming!

🔥 Top Tier Tweets! 
If you manage to clinch 8 consecutive match wins, you'll earn yourself a spot in the limelight! Win 8 times in a row and we’ll shout you out on Twitter, for posterity. Just remember, this time it’s matches, not rounds! 

🥇 Hall of Fame
Check out our brand new Hall of Fame feature in the Play Online section. To grab a spot, you guessed it, you’ll have to bag 8 back-to-back match victories or more! It's not just about winning; it's about etching your name into Move or Die history! 

Last but not least, thank you for 8 incredible years of laughter, loudness and awesome memories. Here's to an infinity more! 


Team MoD

notes.title: Welcome To Secret Santa’s Workshop! Don’t touch anything!!
notes.content:
Remember kids, Secret Santa is watching you at ALL TIMES. He knows when you’ve been nice, but especially when you’ve been naughty, and what are the Holidays for if not sharing! 

Brace yourselves for another instalment in our Secret Santa Saga. Ho, Ho, Hope you’ve been honing your skills cuz winners get cookies while losers get dirty hands and a chance to GIT GUD! 

Introducing Secret Santa's Festive Familiars! 

These little floating Familiars will hang around your character during rounds, keeping them company through the mayhem.  Are they there to help or are they just surveilling on behalf of Secret Santa? Well, we made them so cute that you just won't care! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/23b196d370668d6a796d61d29dd4f165e9a7986f.gif

Now that we got you're attention, here's how it all works! 

To get in on the action, all you have to do is play Move or Die during our Holiday Special spanning December 21st to January 4th. 

Spend not-coins on Festive Familiars
Spend your hard earned not-coins on a Festive Familiar from Secret Santa’s personal stash. Each familiar has its own price and you can only purchase them 4 times per day.

Buy Milk and Cookies for Santa 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/5d7d09a1f7eb9174db0f72c2dbbdc0e42b7b0c56.gif

Buy Milk and Cookies to bribe Secret Santa and get an in-game item of random rarity. They can be game modes, mutators or characters, but take care. Santa is famously stingy, so he’ll charge you increasingly more with each transaction! 

You get coal for losing, but can exchange it for goodies once per day

Losing makes Santa sad, so with every round you lose, you'll get increasingly more Coal. Luckily, you can exchange it for items from the Not-A-Store. This transaction is only available once per day, so spend your coal wisely! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/d3a385347f5deb3bb44a25fa68f153d1749f7f41.gif

To conclude, Secret Santa is making his list, checking it twice, and your gaming prowess will determine if you've been naught or nice. Good luck and let the jolly chaos unfold! 

Team MoD

notes.title: Taking a breather this Holiday Season with the Too Cozy To Care winter update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

With so much going on all the time, caring is getting to be a bit of a chore, especially during the holidays. That’s why, for this winter update, we’re tuning out the trauma and opening up our hearts to all things cozy! 

From cuddles to hot cocoa and perfectly fitting snuggies, this update is all about kicking back and taking a breather while the world goes to heck around us. 

First of all, we have a tender trio of cozy characters you should all get to know! 
 Brady, the spa loving sloth with a heart of “not caring about your problems.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/90a75daded5926f4c3e8de63fdd5dcdd102ce1df.gif 
 Blanket, you average hot cocoa enjoyer that simply can’t be bothered

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/c8003cd092e99dd5cb0730fb991a9a4799f8f43a.gif
  Cuddles, the festive kitty that loves chaos but also sleeps 16 hours a day 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/38ca764c82b0d08e5c74584cb3df81f4adf659fb.gif

That’s about it for our snug little winter update. We hope it made things just a little bit comfier for you, wherever you may be. Next year, the madness starts anew with a whole slew of surprises waiting to be announced. But until then, please enjoy your cozy holidays! 

P.S. We finally "fixed" TacoMan <3.

All the best, 
Team MoD

notes.title: This fall, we Splice It Up with our Halloween Mini-Update!
notes.content:
As the leaves do their thing and seasonal depression sets in, we wanted to mix things up a bit for our yearly Halloween Update. And by “things” we definitely mean body parts. 
 
Please give a warm welcome to our latest seasonal special - The Splice It Up Mini-Update! 
 
So there’s this doctor, right? And he likes to take a little bit of this and a little bit of that and then put everything back together in no discernable order, like if Humpty Dumpty was operated on by Frankenstein. Some of the good doctor’s ensuing monstrosities have somehow escaped and are now on the loose, terrorizing average Joes. The least you can do is get to know them, maybe that’ll give you some sort of upper hand: 
 

 Sharkmera is what happens when you cross a shark, a fly and uhm… a couple of other things. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/03c8eb8eaa4ac47576c7d2464338bf38c5f040fe.gif
 Mouthclops is a failed experiment in seeing if you counteract morning breath with bedroom eyes. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/35c3617994ff05aff4b2b16c87c6b38e76e492fd.gif
 Constraintine had a fear of missing out that tragically turned into a reality of missing parts.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/062eaf738ff4ee57064dc9cb0ca8573d260801e3.gif
 Last but not least, Swampear is what happens when you ask the wrong person to “grow a pear.” 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/9ec6570c607f21a27569de8ec1a83b64c359bb5a.gif

 
We’ll go out on a limb and guess you’ll have a blast losing friends and causing mayhem in these skins. 
As with every Halloween update, we’ve also given Move or Die a monstrous makeover, complete with pools of blood, sinister sounds and pictures that you’ll see in Rorschach form for years to come! 

There are creepy cosmetics to be had, with items such as DNA trails and Chalk Outline death splatters up for grabs as soon as the update goes live. And as an extra treat, we're bringing all the Dead by Daylight Collab items back in rotation, just in case you missed them the first time around. You can do this if you play an online match between October 25th, 10 AM PDT - November 8th, 10 AM PDT.

 
Thanks for stopping by and stay tuned for more awesome news to come. 

- Team Move or Die 🐔

notes.title: Move or Die and Dead by Daylight present: the Thrill of the Hunt Update!
notes.content:
Hey there buds or shall we say survivors? 😱


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/83f5add0d954339ab85daca7ea744c3cc98cb7ab.gif


This summer, Dead by Daylight and Move or Die try to play nice together in the aptly dubbed Thrill of the Hunt Update! Surprised? Careful, that’s one of the first steps in getting yourself murdered. 

Here’s what you’ll find or, more probably, what may find you in this killer collaboration! 


Killers on the loose

This wouldn’t be much of a guest appearance without us giving the ol’ Move or Die makeover to some of Dead by Daylight’s creepiest killers… plus Genny! You can now bump in the dark, especially when playing with the Lights Off mutator, against certified slayers like Trapper, Huntress or Blight, but also sigh in relief at the sight of Genny, a lighter addition to our roster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/35d58534d427ad4b9211e5343add50b342459f0f.gif


Blood-curdling cosmetics 

Killers often leave their mark at the scene of the crime, so we came up with some appropriate items for you to hang on to while cowering in fear. There’s a Scratches Trail to let others know that danger is near, a new Dead by Daylight-inspired Emote Wheel for when you’re too terrified to talk and new Death Splatters for when you inevitably meet your demise. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/be1266e054475f18b21a34d7a790b1ab07974fc8.gif

All of the new characters and cosmetics will be unlocked at random by playing online matches. 


Game Mode Makeover
 
To keep up with this update’s killer theme, certain game modes have also gotten the horror treatment - Radiation, Loot Grab and Spike Ball are now adorned with Dead by Daylight cosmetics which will be available for a month from now. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/85e8ec0c9832e8ece965bed80b510e3a641f5fbd.gif


Last but not least, we’re unlocking 6 New Community Debt Characters for you to enjoy. As per usual, all you have to do to unlock them is contribute to the ever-increasing Community Debt Bar.

For more info on everything we've added, tweaked, fixed, and made spooky:
👉 Head over to our patchnote list!

Before we say goodbye, we’d like to thank the awesome people at Dead by Daylight for making this crossover update possible. For a bunch of stone-cold killers, they seem really nice. 


Now go out there and make a killing! 
See ya in the bloody lobby \o
- Team Move or Die

notes.title: Is this thing cursed? Check out our NEWEST GAME MODE - Pandora’s Blast!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We teased you, now it’s time to please you! It's been a cool minute since we last came up with a new game mode ,but now it's time to deliver. Pandora's Blast is ready to make its big Move or Die debut starting today! Let’s take a peek inside, shall we?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/ea17d59d5228098436a2db63a115eb9054fc11c0.png

A tale tailor-made for troublemakers

It all started with our 6-Year Adventure, which like the past actual year, quickly turned kind of grim. As our four trouble-seeking protagonists went about their yearly anniversary tour, they found themselves blundering about an ancient temple. One thing led to another and one of them, most likely Count, couldn’t help themselves and opened the mysterious Pandora’s Box. This promptly led to every evil breaking free into the world starting with the damned box itself. Some of these evils are worse than others, with a few even taking Joe form and finding their way into Move or Die. 

The all seeing eyes of ouch!

The gist of the curse is straightforward. To survive Pandora’s wrath all you have to do is hide from her all-seeing eyes and evade their beams of death. The last Joe standing is spared and gets to declare himself the winner. If it sounds a bit unnerving it’s because it is: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/143c7560adca885ac38c5a8f0c8ddf11d0879276.gif

To get this new Rare-rated game mode all you have to do is provide the appropriate amount of Not-Coins and enjoy the havoc. 

Another thing worth mentioning is that the drop rates for game modes and mutators has been tweaked since the 6 Year Anniversary Update rolled out and we’d really appreciate the community’s input on this change and if it’s been noticeable so far. Please let us know in the comments or on our dedicated Discord channel. We're really trying to find a good balance for this, that makes the unlocks feel rewarding for everyone involved. 

A silver lining for a sinister curse

Now, preaching all doom and destruction can get a little dull, so here are a few positive things we can look forward to in the following months.  

Another great game-mode is in the making that we’re pretty sure you’ll absolutely die for. It’s a bona-fide killer! Make sure you join our Community Discord Server to get the latest news, and while you’re at it why not make some game-mode suggestions of your own? We’ve made a “game ideas” channel specifically for this, so check that out too - Join the Discord Game Suggestion Channel

Last but definitely not least, get your thinking-chicken-caps ready for The Community Character Collaboration (contest)! We’re opening submissions for new Move or Die characters and are in dire need of dumb ideas. Make sure to check out our Discord server because all the details, as well as submissions themselves, will be posted in the #character-collab channel - Join the Discord Community Character Collab Channel

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/6679178905c21a5a345de820214fdd48d7ed6e7a.gif

That’s it for now but stay tuned for other exciting friendship-ruining announcements!
- Team Move or Die

notes.title: NEW UPDATE! - 6 Year Anniversary Update for Move or Die!
notes.content:
Hey there gang!

Remember that last update where we made a ton of promises? Those sounded good, right? Well, we came to deliver with the MOVE OR DIE 6th ANNIVERSARY UPDATE! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/20c369f83441c63200f58172ba79f91616c8811b.png

That's right, some of you die-hard fans have been playing our party game for 6 whole years! Time sure flies when you're having fun! Doesn't it just fill you with existential dread? Now, let's all calm down a little bit and finally get back to addressing those promises that we made. 

First of all, we finally have a new game mode in the pipeline!!! It's not launching today, as we're still doing some last minute balancing and testing, but you shall be able to play it very soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/7b3e5aed9e6e863a862d17f94047d9738c2cf1a7.gif

This first new game mode is called Pandora's Blast! We don't wanna spoil too much about it, but you can be sure that avoiding those demonic eyes is gonna be one of your top priorities.

Complementing the new mode, we have the titular Pandora’s Box as a character! This box loves making people miserable, and hopefully you can use it to make your friends hate you even more than they already do. I mean, that's the point of the game right?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/9520bd47162cef0d7aaf345b22f324df08c71ef3.gif

You can get Pandora's Box by simply playing an online match during the next couple of weeks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/eada806a5fdc64112ecd5914a220a103de4a52be.gif

But the box ain’t all, as we have a whole slew of new characters coming to the Community Debt Unlock Bar! Some quick spoilers below, for your personal enjoyment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/9a76334221550f10c262c804a563e73d15e7299f.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/c3c85d93ab75e3016c94ac6f6e2152bdc8cca34f.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/6c498eaf2e2b89afee7b7be34bf735ab176c57fd.gif

Wow, we are really getting stuffed with characters, huh? And speaking of the Community Debt Bar, remember all of last year's characters? Well, since you've most likely missed some of them, we're giving you a second chance. All of the 2021 released cosmetics will now be available in the Not-A-Store and Bid Wars rotation.

Of course, this means a new Daily Contribution season is starting today, so your previous progress has been reset.

As promised, there's a whole lot of bug fixes and quality of life improvements that we plan on bringing to the game in 2022. This update will contain the first set of changes that we think will make the game more stable and enjoyable. To check out the most recent changes, please head on out to the Patch Notes page on our website.

Thank you for sitting through all that, we appreciate your time and hope it was worth it. 

To reward all your hard work, here's a sneak peek at what’s coming next, later this year: 

 some exciting crossover content you will NOT expect 
 more bug fixes and quality of life improvements
 more game modes
 more mutators
 many more cute characters and cosmetics
 and more Move or Die fun!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/4b5ae01c9a195e8f9712dbdceb9b6e9103d0ded3.png

Make sure to follow us on Twitter and join the community on our Discord Server!

We hope you enjoy, and thank you for playing.
- Team Move or Die

notes.title: Addressing Apple’s lack of support for 32-bit apps on its latest macOS 10.15
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/a9fc66690203872c187df71ae32eda02d1211b91.jpg

With the recent release of its latest macOS 10.15, Apple has officially renounced support for 32-bit applications. As you may or may not know, this is also the case for Move or Die, which will no longer be available to play on macOS Catalina devices. Unfortunately, trying to fix this situation is simply not feasible on our part, the reasons why being among the following:


 The lack of support for 32-bit apps on Catalina would require us to rebuild the game's engine as 64-bit and also fix any issues that might crop up along the way.

 We've also developed Move or Die on an old version of the Love2D engine, with a bunch of custom options. Because of these options, switching to a newer version of Love2D would require a lot of work which we have decided against in the past due to lack of time and resources.

 Love2D also uses many other libraries. Going 64-bit is likely to break some of them and while upgrading those libraries to their newer versions would help with the 64-bit transition, this could also cause horrible compatibility issues.

 Then, there's also the OpenGL issue. Apple hasn't completely killed off OpenGL support, but they have announced that they are phasing it out to support their Apple only Metal API. Unfortunatelly, Love2D heavily depends on OpenGL.


That being said, for any Apple user that will not be making the switch to macOS 10.15 Catalina, Move or Die will continue to work as intended.

Obviously, we know that this is not an excuse and that it is a big issue for people who do still decide to update, or for those who will be purchasing new Apple products in the years to come.

We will make sure that these compatibility issues are properly explained and highlighted on the Steam Store Page.

Thank you for supporting us ever since Move or Die came out in Early Access in 2015. Back then, we promised to always keep our game open, updated and available on all PC platforms and we have managed to do so without flaw.

It seems that this time, we have reached a point where things are just out of our reach.

See you in the lobby! 

- Those Awesome Guys Team

notes.title: Upcoming Item System Overhaul
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6909713/f1e54cef23ff7f7836c412d56e9bf67fece18418.jpg

Hello there friends and hoarders!

Recently we’ve been taking some good long looks in the mirror every morning and the general consensus was that we definitely need to cut down on the carbs. 

Also, some of our older implemented systems probably need a little grooming.

TL;DR:

  We’re retiring the Steam-based item inventory system.
  There’s gonna be a newly designed one WITHIN the actual game. 
  Your current Move or Die items will be converted from Steam Inventory items to in-game items.
  Progression remains strictly related to playing the game (put that sense of accomplishment back in your wallet).
  No downtime between system shifts (you won't feel a thing).
  You won’t loose anything and you will retain the value of current duplicates! (all items you had previously will be converted to the new system).
  Reward system is also getting tweeks. Random rewards and unlocks will still be in, but future duplicates will still be useful through a new system.
  Less confusion, more awesomeness!
  It’s coming before the end of the year.


There’s a new devblog up on our website that’s gonna walk you through the entire thought process behind our future changes and what you can expect in the coming weeks. 

Read all about it!

Keep being awesome
~finch

notes.title: Delay until January 2015
notes.content:
Hello everybody!...

Long story short
Man, it sucks to have to do this, however, today I had to make the decision of delaying the release date by a month.

The game is pushed back and will be released in the middle of January... this makes me more frustrated than you.

Why?
The reason behind this delay is that, basically, the planets haven't aligned properly... the Steam Winter Sales are around the corner and releasing during that period would be suicidal, resulting in a complete overshadowing of the game. Aside from that, there is also the problem of the game needing a little more attention. I mean, sure, we could put it out next week, but I would rather have a bit more time to test out the latest implemented features, making sure the game won't explode and burn on launch.

Game Status
For the past few weeks I've been working on some awesome things related to the release of the game, some nice videos and a really cool looking announcement page. However, all of those will have to wait a bit more. Game wise, we've been polishing the overall "playing online" experience and it needs some extra days of bug fixing for it to reach a rather stable state.

After working 2 years on this, I don't really want to try my chances with an unstable build released during a major event and this makes it even harder for me because an extra month of development costs a lot more money, money that are quickly running out from my pocket... 

Ethics
I could easily take the cheap route that is very common in this industry, called "pre-orders" to get quick funds for the game, but I don't think paying for a promise is a good idea and nobody should do that. Move or Die is developed for you guys and I want to make sure that by the time you get to buy it, you are absolutely sure of its quality. I would rather take the expensive risk of pushing the game back a month rather than releasing a sub-par version of it and I'm sure you guys understand that.

Quality comes before money.

Having to be the one making these decisions sucks...
See you on the other side of the sales!

~ Nick (Xelu)
